scope: classification and preservation assessment for the four no-Git v0 projects; no Lane-D deployment pagination duplicated
classification_rules: Distinct Vercel project IDs prove four distinct project entities, not four distinct historical codebases.
No Git binding, no current domain, no current latest deployment and terminal deployment count=0 do not prove a historical project was empty.
Do not infer duplicate content from close creation timestamps or generated v0 names.
Without an accessible historical deployment ID, deployment filesystem/build-output preservation cannot be claimed through the current connector surface.
All unresolved content questions remain explicit gaps rather than being converted into empty/duplicate conclusions.

remaining_gaps: No accessible historical deployment ID or deployment payload exists for any of the four projects on the current connected Vercel deployment-history surface.
